titulo: Live: New Russian strikes hit Kyiv bridge as Germany's Merz visits
cuerpo: Kyiv’s North bridge was hit in a new Russian attack on Sunday, Mayor Vitali Klitschko said, soon after German Chancellor Friedrich Merz arrived in Ukraine's capital. Merz is on a surprise visit to demonstrate European support in the face of an upsurge in Russian attacks on Ukrainian infrastructure. Follow our liveblog for all the latest developments.
